title: Case review
entryEmpty: Muse Wonder checks your whole case for what could go wrong
acceptedStep: Proposed by the case review; you accepted the date.
deadlineAddFailed: Couldn’t add the deadline. Try again.
runFailed: The review couldn’t run. Try again in a minute.
unchanged: Nothing changed since the last review
runningNote: Muse Wonder is reading your whole case · {s}s. About a minute.
noReviewBody: Muse Wonder reads your whole case, every letter, date and document, and looks for what could go wrong: risks, a dated plan, things that don’t match, and questions to answer.
disclaimer: Muse Wonder can be wrong. Proposals change nothing until you accept them, and Dossierly never files anything for you.
